top_signals.title: UK Greenlights Major North Sea Gas Field After Years of Legal Battles
top_signals.summary: A major gas field in the North Sea has been re-approved by the government following years of legal rows with environmental campaigners. The Jackdaw site, a large offshore natural gas field 150 miles east of Aberdeen, has received the official stamp of approval from the government and is expected to supply gas to the UK “by the end of the month”. The project was first green-lit back in 2022, but has faced successful legal challenges from activists over its climate impact. Multiple industry bodies and US President Donald Trump have urged…

top_signals.title: Commission to investigate how Booking.com combats scams and fraud under the Digital Services Act
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 21 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission has opened formal proceedings to assess whether Booking.com may have breached the Digital Services Act (DSA) by not having diligently assessed or effectively mitigated risks related to fraudulent listings and phishing scams.
